name: Buffalo Chicken Pasta Bake
intro_html: Buffalo wings and mac and cheese had a baby, and it costs about $2.74 a bowl (at everyday cost). Ziti in a creamy ranch and cream cheese sauce with a proper buffalo kick, loaded with 41 grams of protein at 606 calories per serving. Game-day flavor, Tuesday-lunch logistics.
ingredients_display: 1/3 Fat Cream Cheese (Great Value): 21 oz (595 g)
Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 2.25 lb (980 g)
cost_note_html: Real Omaha store prices from our weekly grocery board (2026). They still swing by store and by what is on sale.
cost_lines: Ranch Seasoning Mix, 3.5 tbsp: ~$0.42. Buy 1 (lasts several batches).
Buffalo Wing Sauce, 0.75 cups: ~$0.94. Buy 1 (lasts several batches).
Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast, 2.25 lb: ~$4.82. Buy 3 lbs: $6.69.
Pantry seasonings (salt, black pepper): ~$0.20. From jars you keep on hand.

Batch total: about $17.04 across 14 servings, so roughly $1.22 per bowl. This counts only the amounts this batch actually uses from each package, so it is the cost of the food in the containers, not a register receipt.

True shopping cost: about $25.56 across 14 servings, roughly $1.83 per bowl. What the register trip looks like if your pantry is already stocked. Meat, produce, and packaged items are counted as the whole packages you have to buy, since you cannot grab a partial box, can, or jar. Pantry staples you already own (rice, seasonings, oils, and long-lasting sauces) are counted at only what this batch uses.

Starting with an empty pantry? Add about $7.43 one time. That is the extra cost of buying full containers of every pantry staple in this recipe instead of just the amounts used, which puts a first shopping trip near $32.99. Those containers then feed this batch and many more after it.
cost_closing_html: About $2.74 a bowl (at everyday cost) for buffalo chicken pasta that a wing joint would charge several times as much for, and they would still skimp on the sauce.
shop_smart: Chicken breast at the 3 lb size beats the small trays on price per pound, and this recipe only needs 2.25 lb, so the extra goes to the freezer.
One-third fat cream cheese costs the same as full fat, melts smoother into a sauce, and trims the calories. Buy the store-brand bricks, not the tubs; bricks are cheaper per ounce.
The gallon of milk is the play even though you only need 7 cups. Per ounce it crushes the half gallon, and cereal exists.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Preheat the oven to 375F. Cube the chicken breast, season with salt and pepper, and cook it in a skillet over medium-high until it reaches 165F. Set aside.
Boil the ziti in salted water until 2 minutes shy of al dente, then drain.
In your largest pot, melt the butter over medium heat, whisk in the flour, and cook 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer 3 to 4 minutes until it thickens enough to coat a spoon.
Whisk in the cream cheese until smooth, then the ranch seasoning and buffalo wing sauce.
Fold in the cooked chicken and ziti until everything is coated, then spread into two 9x13 pans.
Top with the mozzarella and bake 15 to 20 minutes until melted and bubbling at the edges. Rest 5 to 10 minutes before combining into your weighed pot.
portion_html: Weigh the full pot, subtract the empty-pot weight, and divide by 14. Scoop even portions into 14 containers; the sauce keeps it creamy through a week of reheats. Each bowl checks in at 606 calories and 41 grams of protein.
credit_html: Recipe adapted from Easy Chicken Recipes, rebuilt for 14-serving budget meal prep with weighed portions and Omaha pricing.

head.description: Buffalo chicken pasta bake meal prep with creamy ranch cream cheese sauce and mozzarella. 606 calories, 41g protein, about $2.74 per serving (at everyday cost).

recipeIngredient: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast, 2.25 lb (980 g)
steps: Cube and cook the chicken to 165F, and boil the ziti 2 minutes shy of al dente.
Make a roux with butter and flour, then whisk in milk and simmer until thickened.
Whisk in cream cheese, ranch seasoning, and buffalo sauce.
Fold in the chicken and pasta, spread into two pans, and top with mozzarella.
Bake at 375F for 15 to 20 minutes, rest, and portion into 14 containers.
